basis: Definition identifies a large-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma; no specific extranodal organ involvement established.
Carcinoma originating in cutaneous sweat glands; metastatic sites are not established as affected in at least 30%.
Developmental disability, skin abnormalities and skeletal/joint defects define the syndrome; cardiac defects/cardiomyopathy affect most. Frequent ocular and dental abnormalities omitted by cap.
Mitochondrial disorder with profound developmental impairment and cardiomyopathy; optic atrophy in 2/2. Muscle atrophy and hearing loss each in 1/2 omitted by cap.
Congenital external auditory canal atresia causes conductive hearing impairment; hyposmia frequency is unspecified.
Autoimmune lupus-specific skin disease; systemic lupus is a separately diagnosed condition.
HADH deficiency causes hyperinsulinemic hypoketotic hypoglycemia; supplied liver, cardiac and neurologic findings lack evidence of persistent damage in at least 30%.
Muscular dystrophy with ptosis and ophthalmoplegia in 11/11. Respiratory insufficiency and dysphagia reflect muscle weakness, without established lung or gastrointestinal tissue damage.
Developmental delay/intellectual disability commonly defines partial trisomy 10 syndromes; additional organ malformations vary with the duplicated segment.
Iron metabolism disorder with hepatic fibrosis in 80-99%; cardiomyopathy and arthropathy each 30-79%. Endocrine dysfunction shares the metabolic axis; pigmentation alone is not skin damage.
Meningioma of the pineal region is a CNS meningeal tumor; an endocrine tumor origin is not established.
Caveolinopathies are skeletal muscle disorders; neurologic ancestry does not establish direct nerve damage, and cardiac disease is not common across the group.
LRAT-associated congenital retinal dystrophy causes severe visual loss; no common extraocular organ damage established.
Infection directly affects the cornea.
Congenital anterior segment dysgenesis involving the iris, pupil and anterior chamber; distinct from systemic Rieger syndrome.
Lysosomal storage with skeletal disease ~80%; cardiac abnormalities 80-99%, neurodegeneration ~60-70%. Common airway disease, hearing loss and retinopathy omitted by cap.
Primary tuberculosis infection involving pulmonary tissue; extrapulmonary disease is not inherent to this concept.
Generalized subcutaneous fat loss with insulin resistance and dyslipidemia; hepatic steatosis in 2/2 and elevated transaminases support direct hepatic involvement.
Inherited retinal degeneration; no common extraocular involvement established.
Malignancy directly involving the nervous system; other organs depend on the individual tumor subtype or origin.
Early-onset arterial hypertension; renal, cardiac and cerebral complications are separately diagnosed and not inherent to this concept.
Inherited kidney disease with reduced filtration, sclerosis, tubular atrophy and interstitial injury; gout, hypertension and hypercholesterolemia are separate conditions.
Inflammatory fungal infection of scalp skin and hair follicles, potentially causing scarring alopecia; reactive lymphadenopathy does not establish blood-organ damage.
Oral mucosal lesion with severe epithelial dysplasia or carcinoma; oral mucosa belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Umbrella for acquired metabolic disorders; no additional organ is consistently damaged across its diverse subtypes.
